title: Discord Transport
purpose: Connects the house add-ons to Discord.
description: Holds the one Discord bot login and reads each Discord channel once. Other Intelligent Home add-ons answer through it, so only this add-on ever sees the login. It can also create and tidy channels for add-ons that are allowed to. It starts in test mode, where it sends nothing.
navigation: Passes messages to the other add-ons
